notes.title: Life Update & Game Direction: More Parkour, More Focus!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, just wanted to share a little life update! I recently got a job (IT-support), which is great news, but it also means that progress on Roman Legacy: Speed Trials is going to slow down. That said, I’m still working on it, and a new version with a different, more parkour-focused gameplay style is coming soon, without the weapon, but the abilities stay—possibly this month, but definitely by next!

With this new direction, I’m also making a big change—the weapon is being removed to put full focus on parkour and movement. However, the abilities will stay, so there will still be mechanics beyond just running and jumping.

I’ve been leaning more and more into a Mirror’s Edge-like experience, really focusing on movement and parkour, while having a story. Even though things might take longer, I’m excited about where this is heading and can’t wait to share more with you all. I believe that this is a right way to go. What are some of your favorite parkour mechanics in games? Anything you’d love to see in a first-person parkour platformer?

Thanks for sticking around, and I really appreciate all the support!

notes.title: Update 0.4.2.0 New Gameplay Feature, Animation Upgrades, and more!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! I’m back with Update 0.4.2.0 for Roman Legacy: Speed Trials, and we’ve made some fantastic progress I’m excited to share with you! Just for a reminder, I am now using this update formatting: [FullRelease.MajorVersion.MinorVersion.Hotfix]

Key Gameplay Updates

    Predictive Animation System: This system lets the character anticipate ledge grabs, making movements feel more responsive.Improved movement animation blending, this helps characters move more naturally, smoothly transitioning between directions while maintaining consistent behavior for competitive gameplay experience. Enhanced Ledge Grab Mechanics: Even though this mechanic certainly needs more work, it's still quite functional. It adds more dynamic ledge interactions with new animations, and now you can also shimmy left or right. This change creates a more varied and natural feel ("realistic").New Cable Slide Feature(Level 13): Completely new mechanic — cable slides! You can now zip between points, making traversal faster and smoother, bringing an extra layer of fluidity to parkour gameplay.Level Blockout Inspired by Mirror’s Edge (Level 13): I’ve blocked out the first level inspired by rooftops. While it’s still in its early stages, this level is the perfect testing ground for the new movement and traversal updates. Improved Landing System: You can now roll out of a high fall to maintain momentum, or stumble if you miss the timing. This change keeps the flow of movement intact and rewards precise, skillful play.Various other small fixes and changes.

Coming Next

Looking ahead, I’m experimenting with adjusting the movement speed. Currently, it feels a bit too fast to deliver the satisfying experience I’m aiming for. This will require some reworking of existing levels—a change I’m excited to dive into. This tweak should bring focus to high-altitude, rooftop-centric parkour, which I think will greatly enhance the gameplay, but we will see how it turns out!

Stay tuned for the next update post in December, where I’ll share more on this movement speed adjustment experiment and reveal my 2025 development plans for Roman Legacy: Speed Trials. Thanks for your support and feedback, and see you in the next update!

notes.title: Online Leaderboards and Character Controller Improvements - MAJOR Update 0.4.0.0
notes.notes:
Hey Everyone!
It's time for a major update [v0.4.0.0], and we've made some significant progress since the last one. I'm excited to share everything we've achieved so far. The game is shaping up nicely, and I can't wait to eventually bring the full version to you!
TL;DR
Major update! Implemented online leaderboards. Updated the character controller with lots of new animations for actions that previously had none and improved the "flow". Introduced a new player character. Created a Pause Menu. Additionally fixed some bugs and other issues.
Jump Into the Playtest and Experience These Updates Below Firsthand! Your Feedback and Criticism Is Always Welcomed!
  Online leaderboards! Compete against your friends and others with always upto date leaderboard times!    This also includes a small improvement on the UI    Updated the player character to something more appropriate! It's not final though but 100 (might be a slight overestimation) times better than the old.  Improved several aspects of the character controller    	Added multiple animations, such as wall running up, ledge grab and improved normal wall running animation    Ledge grab feels far more smoother now. You can also now turn "in AND from" the ledge grab, which is a large part of it    Wall running up looks visually better (camera positioning)   Created a Pause Menu      Access Settings, Binds and Level Selector Menus, you can also Quit the Game from There      Some of the most "notable" bug fixes    Fixed a bug where after ledge grab ends, the player sometimes does a small hop.    Roll Landing no longer has a abrupt jerking motion on the camera when the rolling sequence ends. Now the camera returns smoothly to the desired position    Fixed a bug when you do a roll landing after exiting a wall run up, the incorrect animation plays    Wall running up now stops at the top of the "wall" instead of continuing through the air    Wall running up cannot be started anymore on low height "walls", such as horizontal pipes    Fixed an issue where, when ledge grabbing certain objects, those objects became "movement" noninteractable, except ledge grabbing, making that the only interaction that is still possible.    Kept building on some of the unfinished levels, managed to complete few of them (Note: "First Art Pass", so it's not final)  And other various fixes and bugfixes! 

Stay tuned for next update!

notes.title: V0.3.2.0 Small Update!
notes.notes:
Heya!

From now on, I will be using versions so you can get a better idea where we are at, with following formatting: [FullRelease.MajorVersion.MinorVersion.Hotfix]

Small update for you guys, here is the bullet list of changes:


     Added a ESCAPE Menu. You can access settings, binds and level selector from there. You can also quit the game from this menu ([F8] shortcut still stays)
     Because of this, level selector was moved to [CAPS] key (It was previous [ESC]
     Worked on few of the obviously unfinished levels. So some "improvements" there so decided to include them. They are not finished yet though.
     Modified some tutorial messages
     Other small lightning, gameplay and UI changes/fixes.


Hope to see you soon again :)!
